question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Cherish
solution:
The correct answer is **“Admire" **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• '**Cherish**' means to hold something or someone dear or to appreciate considerably. (स्नेह रखना)

 
 
• **Example**- She cherished her children above all else.
 
 
 
• '**Admire**' means respect and warm approval, and this respect could be for something or someone that one cherishes.(सम्मान और हार्दिक अनुमोदन)
 
 
• **Example**- He admires her for her dedication to the cause.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is Similar in meaning to 'Cherish' is 'Admire’.

Therefore, the correct answer is ‘**Option 4**’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options.
 
• '**Condemn**' means express complete disapproval of, typically in public. (निंदा करना) 
 
• '**Abandon**' means to give up completely or to desert. (त्यागना)
 
• '**Neglect**' means to fail to care for properly. (उपेक्षा करना)
